name: 10953-sharedprefix-dsv2lite-1gpu
parallelism: tp1, one GPU of an 8-GPU node. No pipeline, data or expert parallelism, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 27 layers, MLA, 64 routed + 2 shared experts, 15.7B total / 2.4B active, bf16, ~31 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 1024 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over /v1/completions, single turn: one shared 8192-token leading context (prefix_buckets: one bucket, prefix_count 1) followed by a per-request body of ~4096 tokens (stdev 512, clamped 3072-5120), generating ~128 tokens (stdev 32, clamped 64-256). Seed 42.
purpose: A repository-aware coding assistant answering 16 concurrent long-context queries that share one 8192-token codebase preamble on a single GPU.
launch:
# Server arguments for sglang at commit 92009bd28e8d05f11bd951e292e5705d3a63d101 (v0.5.4-11).
# host / port / served-model-name are owned by the serving layer and are not set here.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1

attention-backend: fa3
kv-cache-dtype: fp8_e4m3
page-size: 1
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
context-length: 16384
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 42
